## Source
.design/m5/48-tpm-signing.md — REQ-1, REQ-5, REQ-6, AC-1 + decomposition PR 2.

## Surface
- `polaris-backend/src/labeler/signer/tpm.rs` — main impl
- `polaris-backend/src/labeler/signer/tpm/error.rs` — `TpmError` enum
- `polaris-backend/tests/tpm_signing.rs` — swtpm fixture integration test (#[ignore]-marked for hardware-less CI)

## Rust-quality notes
- **Impl `SigningKey` for `TpmSigningKey`** with `sign()` + `public_key()` — same signatures as the v1 four impls.
- **`TpmError` is `thiserror`** with the five variants from REQ-5: `Unavailable`, `SealPolicyMismatch { found, sealed }`, `PcrUpdateRequired`, `HandleNotFound`, `SigningFailed(#[from] tss_esapi::Error)`. All Send + Sync.
- **Esys_Context lifetime**: a `Drop` impl on `TpmSigningKey` closes the session via `Esys_FlushContext`. Per rust-quality §2: RAII for the TPM session.
- **No `unsafe` in this file.** All FFI is inside `tss-esapi`. Per design REQ-7.
- **`sign()` is synchronous**; callers from async wrap via `tokio::task::spawn_blocking`. Document this constraint in the trait impl's doc-comment.
- **Public-key caching**: extract once at construction via `Esys_ReadPublic`; cache the `PublicKey` so `public_key()` is hot-path-free.
- Per rust-quality §7: integration test signs a known payload, verifies via `proto-blue-crypto::verify_signature` against the extracted public key.

## External references
- tss-esapi context lifecycle: https://docs.rs/tss-esapi/latest/tss_esapi/context/
- v1 SigningKey trait: `polaris-backend/src/labeler/signer/mod.rs`

## Acceptance (AC-1)
- [ ] swtpm fixture integration test signs a payload + verifies signature against `public_key()`.
- [ ] Test marked `#[ignore]`; runs via `cargo test --test tpm_signing -- --ignored`.
